input.quote: (b) NON SOLICITATION. During the Term of this Agreement and during the three year period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates to leave his or her employment with Licensor.
input.rationale: Article X(b) binds only Licensee (one-way), covers every person employed by Licensor and its Affiliates rather than only personnel involved in the services, and runs three years after expiration or termination — well past the 12-month fallback limit. The existing "Solicit" definition already excludes general job advertising and responsive/voluntary employment inquiries, and there is no no-hire element, so the failures are mutuality, personnel scope and duration. Our edit makes the restriction mutual, limits it to persons directly involved in the services under this Agreement, and caps it at 12 months after that individual's involvement ends (removing the open-ended "during the Term" plus three-year post-termination tail), leaving the favourable carve-out sentence verbatim. The preferred position is no non-solicit on Licensee at all, which we would raise as the opening ask.

mappings.element: The restriction covers only personnel directly involved in the Services.
The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months after the person's involvement ends.
General advertisements are excluded from the restriction.
mappings.quote: but shall not mean generally advertising job openings

mappings.element: Unsolicited approaches are excluded from the restriction.
mappings.quote: or any activities that constitute follow-up to individuals who respond to job opening advertisements or who voluntarily initiate employment inquiries

mappings.element: The restriction does not prohibit hiring.

proposal.summary: Narrow one-way three-year non-solicit to mutual, 12 months, involved personnel only
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We made the non-solicit mutual, limited it to personnel directly involved in the services and capped it at 12 months after that individual's involvement ends instead of three years post-termination; the existing carve-outs for general job advertising and voluntary inquiries are retained.

ops.oldText: During the Term of this Agreement and during the three year period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates to leave his or her employment with Licensor.
ops.newText: Until 12 months after the end of an individual's involvement in the services under this Agreement, neither party will solicit any person employed by the other party and/or its Affiliates who was directly involved in such services to leave his or her employment with that party.
